plan: To maximize long-term profit, bid slightly above half my value to balance winning chances and cost. With a value of $25, bid $13 to outbid low bids while minimizing loss if outbid. This approach considers the worst-case of paying near my value if I win, ensuring profit.

Given the private value of $18, I aim to bid just below or at my value to maximize profit while minimizing loss. The worst-case scenario is bidding my full value and losing to a higher bid, resulting in no profit. A bid slightly below $18, say $17.9, could win if competitors bid lower. This strategy balances the risk of overbidding and underbidding, considering I have no history of past bids to analyze.

Given my private value of $31, I aim to maximize profit by ensuring my bid is below my value. I will bid slightly less to avoid overpaying if I win. The worst-case scenario is bidding too high and paying more than my value, resulting in a loss. I will bid $30, ensuring potential profit if I win and minimizing loss risk.
